Agent ArchieBrand identity case study

AgentArchie

Brand identity and digital system for a real estate operations platform. Real estate operations, simplified.

Move your cursor. Archie is watching the skyline.

The agent behind every deal.

Agent Archie gives real estate brokers one place to run the work around the deal: leads, site visits, bookings and marketing material. The identity treats the platform as a discreet professional who keeps everything in order, so the broker can focus on relationships.

Purpose
Less time managing data, more time closing deals.
Personality
Discreet, sharp, dependable, with a touch of intrigue.
Audience
Real estate brokers and brokerage teams.
Values
Clarity, discretion, structure, momentum.
Concept
A silhouette in front of the skyline: the person behind the city's deals. The keyhole in the I stands for access, because every property has a door and Archie holds the key. The name echoes architecture and arches.

Agent Archie

Guidelines in brief.

Logo

Use the supplied artwork only. Keep clear space equal to the keyhole height. Symbol minimum 16 px.

Colour

Ink and bone carry the layout. Crimson marks action and emphasis. Signal red is for illustration and campaign only.

Type

Bricolage Grotesque for headlines, Hanken Grotesk for everything else. Sentence case.

Layout

Generous margins, one strong headline per view, a thin crimson rule as the accent.

Voice

Plain, active, a little playful. Archie speaks like a reliable colleague.

Accessibility

Ink on bone and white on crimson both pass AA contrast for body text.

Archie keeps the keys.
